Neither is corrected because R cannot be length-matched without dropping |R| below the D-20 bit ceiling, and a smaller R costs more resolution than the confound costs accuracy. The per-slot token-length spread travels beside every exposure number so a reader sees which of the eight slots the confound can reach at all.
